figures.caption: Figure 1: Directed Acyclic Graph of the assumed data generating process when Si = 3. A red arrow with double lines represents a deterministic causal relation while a black arrow with a single line indicates a possibly stochastic relationship.

Figure 2: Diagram Illustrating the Proposed Model Architecture. The proposed model takes an internal representation at each text segment Ris as an input and finds the deconfoudner f(Ris), which is a lower-dimensional representation ofRis. The set of deconfounders at the all text segment, the treatment history W iSi , and the length of the unstructured data Si are then used to predict the outcome Yi.

Figure 5: Estimated average potential outcomes under stochastic interventions that perturb the treatment assignment probability at time 1 (red) and time 2 (blue) separately. The horizontal axis displays the incremental parameter δ, which scales the treatment assignment probability, while the vertical axis reports the corresponding estimated average potential outcome. The value δ = 1 denotes the observed treatment mechanism; δ < 1 attenuates, and δ > 1 amplifies, the probability of treatment.

Table 1: Three example vignettes from the Hong Kong experiment (Fong and Grimmer, 2023). The treatment feature (U.S. commitment to Hong Kong) is absent in Example 1 and appears in different sentence positions in Examples 2 and 3 (highlighted in red).

Figure 4: Performance of the estimator across different sample sizes and values of the incremental parameter δ, based on 200 Monte Carlo iterations. The red dotted line in the bias plot indicates zero, while the red dotted line in the 95% confidence interval coverage plot denotes the nominal coverage level (0.95).

Figure 3: Average estimated potential outcomes (blue) versus their oracle values (black) across different values of the incremental parameter δ, based on 200 Monte Carlo iterations. The blue solid line denotes the mean estimate, and the blue shaded region represents the average confidence interval constructed from the average standard error. The horizontal axis displays the incremental parameter δ, which scales the treatment assignment probability, while the vertical axis reports the corresponding estimated average counterfactual outcome. The value δs = 1 denotes the observed treatment mechanism; δs < 1 attenuates, and δs > 1 amplifies, the probability of treatment for each segment s.
